subject.title: [Bug]: OpenClaw CLI commands remain alive as node.exe processes after execution on Windows

question: Does the current npm package on native Windows still leave `openclaw status` or `openclaw --version` alive after output, and which resource retains the Node event loop if it does?
rationale: The issue has credible older evidence but no verified current-main or current-release result in this review; the answer determines whether the report is already fixed and, if not, the correct lifecycle boundary for a repair.

options.title: Collect current Windows evidence
options.body: Run the supported commands from the current npm package and attach redacted terminal plus process/handle evidence after output.

options.title: Retain for future verification
options.body: Keep the report open as historical Windows regression context until a maintainer can reproduce it on a current packaged build.

recommendation.title: Collect current Windows evidence
recommendation.body: Run the supported commands from the current npm package and attach redacted terminal plus process/handle evidence after output.

likelyOwner.reason: Their prior merged work is the strongest supplied history signal for CLI exit ownership.
